$comment: Classification of every function holding a tokenHash/codeHash digest lookup or an unreadable where on a token model. Enforced by scripts/checks/check-bearer-passkey-gate.mjs (plan: docs/archive/review/api-key-passkey-requirement-plan.md, C7). calls = the number of calls in the function that are a lookup or opaque. Keys are <repo path>#<function>. refresh-bound entries name lifetime as <repo path>#<exported const> and at least one inlineGate. models: a token model (tokenHash/codeHash column) that no analysed lookup reaches, keyed by model name with a reason; empty while every token model has one.

src/lib/auth/tokens/api-key.ts#validateA.reason: API key validator; every use passes the C3 gate after revocation, expiry and membership (C1).

src/lib/auth/tokens/operator-token.ts#va.reason: Operator token validator; every use passes the C3 gate after membership (C2).

src/lib/auth/tokens/extension-token.ts#v.reason: Extension-row token validator (BROWSER_EXTENSION, IOS_APP, IOS_AUTOFILL); every use passes the C3 gate after DPoP, except the three pinned passkeyExemption call sites (C5).

src/lib/mcp/oauth-server.ts#validateMcpT.reason: MCP access token validator; not gated per use (SC1): the token lives MCP_TOKEN_EXPIRY_SEC (1 h) and every mint, by code exchange or refresh rotation, is gated inline.

src/lib/mcp/oauth-server.ts#resolveRefre.reason: Pre-rotation tenant lookup for the IP gate on the MCP refresh grant; authenticates nothing itself — the rotation it precedes is gated inline in exchangeRefreshToken.

src/lib/mcp/oauth-server.ts#exchangeRefr.reason: MCP refresh rotation; passkeyEnforcementBlocks runs inline at the mint point, after replay detection, so a blocked user's 1 h access token cannot be renewed.

src/app/api/mobile/token/refresh/route.t.reason: iOS host refresh-token lookup; the rotation is gated inline in refreshIosToken (SC3), the refresh row lives at most the tenant idle limit, and the access row it mints is gated per use by validateExtensionToken.

src/app/api/extension/token/refresh/rout.reason: Revocation-only replay detection: reads an already-revoked row and can only revoke its family; it grants nothing (the refresh itself goes through validateExtensionToken).

src/lib/mcp/oauth-server.ts#revokeToken.reason: RFC 7009 revocation: the lookup can only revoke the presented token or its family; it grants nothing.

src/lib/auth/tokens/service-account-toke.reason: Service account tokens are not user-bound; a passkey is a human-identity requirement.

src/lib/auth/tokens/scim-token.ts#valida.reason: SCIM tokens are tenant provisioning credentials, not user-bound.

src/app/api/vault/admin-reset/route.ts#h.reason: One-time admin vault reset action token, presented by a signed-in user; not a reusable bearer API credential.

src/app/api/emergency-access/accept/rout.reason: One-time emergency access invitation token, accepted under a session; not a reusable bearer API credential.

src/app/api/emergency-access/reject/rout.reason: One-time emergency access invitation token, rejected under a session; not a reusable bearer API credential.

src/app/api/share-links/verify-access/ro.reason: Share link token: an anonymous recipient capability, not a user-bound credential.

src/app/s/[token]/download/route.ts#GET.reason: Share link token: an anonymous recipient capability, not a user-bound credential.

src/app/s/[token]/page.tsx#SharePage.reason: Share link token: an anonymous recipient capability, not a user-bound credential.

src/app/api/extension/token/exchange/rou.reason: One-time extension bridge code (read, then CAS-consumed); the code's mint is gated and the minted extension token is gated per use by validateExtensionToken (C5).

src/app/api/mobile/token/route.ts#handle.reason: One-time mobile bridge code (read, then CAS-consumed); the code's mint is gated and the minted IOS_APP token is gated per use by validateExtensionToken (C5).

src/lib/mcp/oauth-server.ts#resolveCodeT.reason: One-time MCP authorization code, read only to pick the tenant for the IP gate; the exchange is gated inline and the token is refresh-bound (SC1).

src/lib/mcp/oauth-server.ts#exchangeCode.reason: One-time MCP authorization code exchange, gated inline by passkeyEnforcementBlocks before the mint; the minted token is refresh-bound (SC1).

src/lib/emergency-access/emergency-acces.reason: where is the caller's args.where spread; the digest arrives through it from the accept/reject routes, whose own lookups are classified above. Revocation-style state change, grants no API access.
where is the caller's args.where spread (same as transition); a grant state change that grants no API access.

src/lib/auth/session/user-session-invali.reason: Revokes every token row of a user; the spread is a tenantFilter keyed by userId/tenantId, not a digest. Revocation only.

src/app/api/user/mcp-tokens/[id]/route.t.reason: Revokes a session user's own MCP refresh family; the spread is a familyId/userId/tenantId scope, not a digest. Revocation only.

src/app/api/share-links/route.ts#handleG.reason: Session-authenticated listing of the user's own share links; where is a record built from creator and entry ids, never a digest.

src/app/api/share-links/mine/route.ts#ha.reason: Session-authenticated listing of the user's own share links; where is built from creator/type/status filters and the spread is a cursor, never a digest.

src/app/api/vault/delegation/check/route.reason: DelegationSession lookup whose McpAccessToken relation filter spreads tokenBinding ({ id } of the caller's own already-validated MCP token, or {}); filters by row id, never by digest.
